english.note: Use this for a more formal or general release, especially when a substance or energy is released.

examples.english: This reaction will liberate a lot of heat.
examples.traditional: 呢個反應會釋放大量熱能。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 faan2 jing3 wui5 sik1 fong3 daai6 loeng6 jit6 nang4

english.note: Use this formal term in legal, official, or written contexts for releasing someone from custody or captivity.

examples.english: The court ordered the defendant to be set free.
examples.jyutping: faat3 ting4 haa6 ling6 sik1 fong3 bei6 gou3
